description.p: Whispered is a modern desktop application for transcribing audio and video files using OpenAI's Whisper speech recognition model via whisper.cpp.

ul.li: Drag-and-drop file upload for audio and video files
AI-powered text cleaning and article generation
Export to TXT, SRT, VTT, and JSON formats

description.p: A reworked workspace: a Library of records, a transcript that reads as paragraphs with bookmarks and uncertain passages marked, your own notes for Insights, a menu-bar icon. Brand-deck covers with speaker photos, a three-step YouTube publish wizard, an upload queue and editing of uploaded videos. Batch transcription no longer stalls on the first file.

Publish a finished YouTube package from the app: hand-off dialog and optional upload through the YouTube Data API. The YouTube tab becomes a step viewer with editable chapters, title picker and description blocks.
Initial release with full transcription, AI processing, and batch support.
